name: Skills Lab — list, editor, and an agent's attached skills
description: Walks the three read surfaces the Skills feature added. On /skills, the card grid lists a seeded skill; clicking its card opens the editor directly at /skills/:id on the Config tab (revised 2026-09-20 — the side-panel preview is gone; the editor rail shows the same SkillCard tiles as the grid). The editor's Preview tab is where the rendered Markdown lives. On /agents, opening the seeded Test Quality Reviewer and switching to its Skills tab shows every workspace skill with its attached ones checked, including the 'N of M enabled' count computed from the seeded bindings (pr-quality-rubric and test-coverage-nudge enabled, no-then-chains disabled). Assertions are positive only — agent-browser's `wait --text` has no negative form — so the drag/keyboard reorder and the disabled no-then-chains row are left to SkillsTab.test.tsx and SkillCard.test.tsx, which can assert absence and simulate keyboard reordering directly. No review run is triggered; this suite is read-only against seeded data. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB carrying the Skills Lab seed data from server/src/db/seed.ts (the seven skills in server/src/db/seed-skills.ts — pr-quality-rubric, test-coverage-nudge, the four API Contract skills, no-then-chains — and their agent bindings) — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).

steps.label: seeded skill is listed in the grid
click the card — opens the editor directly
the editor opens in edit mode (Config tab) — no preview panel in between
the Preview tab renders the skill body's heading
the Preview body content renders past the heading
navigate to the agent's editor (default Config tab)
skills tab is active in the URL
enabled-count badge reflects the seeded bindings
the shared bound skill is listed in the agent's Skills tab
the agent-specific bound skill is listed too
